sn54.8:3.2: The body might become fatigued, for example, through many hours of walking meditation. The eyes might become fatigued when focusing on an external object of meditation, such as a corpse, a light, or a color. More generally, since mindfulness of breathing focuses on the principle of life, it is nourishing and sustaining for both body and mind.
sn54.8:4.1: The same rhetorical pattern is used in [mn6]() and [an10.71]().
